'''E.C. "Easy" Nerwal''' was a [[TIE pilot/Legends|TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who became the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]], a unit of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s.<ref name="X-Wing vs TIE Fighter" />

Nerwal and his unit would later be assigned to [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance]], lead by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]]. It was centered around the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']]. They were tasked within [[Spreading the Rebellion|pacify]] the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]].<ref name="X-Wing vs TIE Fighter" />
